rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and zip to locate a single account, then used read-only tools to inspect the user profile and the specified order. It correctly noted there was no laptop in the order and that adding a new product to a pending order wasn’t supported, aligning with tool capabilities. For the address change, the agent checked the profile, found only the Houston address, and appropriately requested the NYC address details rather than inventing them; when the user declined, it left the address unchanged. Before making any order-changing write, the agent summarized the exact change (switch wristwatch dial to black, keep leather strap) and obtained explicit user confirmation. It then checked available variants, executed the modification with the correct item IDs, and a refund was processed; the agent reported the refund accurately and did not fabricate a gift card balance. All actions were performed on the authenticated user’s own order, and the final information matched tool outputs. The user ended satisfied, and no policy violations occurred.
